#### Data preprocessing general input
```{r 01_input_general, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}

params <-
  params_setup( 
    
    run.pipeline = TRUE,
    path.mzml = "J:/CBMR/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Projects/AMP_test_project/mzML/TE_LIP_MS1/",
    
    standard.name = TRUE,  # TRUE, FALSE
    
    # Metadata
    path.meta.pos = "J:/CBMR/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Projects/AMP_test_project/files/AMP_meta.xlsx",
    path.meta.neg = NULL,
    
    meta.match.col = "Sample", # "Sample" for standard.name = TRUE, "Sample.name" for 
    
    # Library match
    rt_tolerance = 0.3,
    mz_tolerance = 0.01,
    
    # Pool samples to use for evaluation
    type.use.to.optimize = "PO",  # For optimizing XCMS parameters
    po.sample.to.use = "PO",      # For evaluate normalization
    
    
    ### Only modify if not standard workflow
    method = NULL,
    path.result = NULL,
    sample.pattern = ".mzML",
    
    # Sample path
    # Put "No_data" if not preprocessing the mode
    path.mzml.pos = NULL,
    path.mzml.neg = NULL,
    
    # Library path
    path.lib = "J:/CBMR/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Workflow/library/library.MS1.rds",
    path.lib.is = "J:/CBMR/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Workflow/library/library.MS1.IS.rds",
    path.msp = "J:/CBMR/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Workflow/library/msdial.library.MS1.rds"

)
```

```{r 02_Extract_precursor, eval = FALSE}

### XCMS setup

params$optimize.xcms.parameters <- TRUE  # TRUE, FALSE

# If not optimize parameters, the following parameters are used:
params$para.pos <-
  list( # para.peak.picking
        max_peakwidth = 0.7*60,
        min_peakwidth = 0.1*60,
        ppm = 10,
        snthresh = 10,
        noise = 500,
        prefilter = 3,
        value_of_prefilter = 500, 
        
        # para.peak.group
        bw = 0.2*60,
        minFraction.1 = 0.5,
        minFraction.2 = 0.7,
        binSize = 0.01,
        
        # para.adjust.rt
        span = 0.6,
        minFraction.ref = 0.8,
        extraPeaks = 2
  )

params$para.neg <-
  params$para.pos

render_rmarkdown(
    file = system.file("rmd", "02_Extract_precursor.Rmd", package="metpipe"),
    #file = 02_Extract_precursor.Rmd",
    params = params[params$Extract_precursor],
    output = paste0( params$path.result, '02_Extract_precursor')
  )

```

```{r 04_Clean_peaktable, eval = TRUE}

### Peaktable

params$path.peaktable.pos <- NULL
params$path.peaktable.neg <- NULL

params$peaktable.sep <- ";"
params$peaktable.sample.pattern <- NULL #".mzML Peak area"

params$mz_col_nr <- 2
params$rt_col_nr <- 3
params$identity_col_nr <- 4
params$others <- c(8)

### Peak cleaning setup

# Feature filtering
params$bl.thres <- c( 3, "BL", "<", "PO")            # 3, mean in PO should be > 3 times BL
params$rsd.po.thres <- c( "PO", "<", 40)        # 50, RSD in PO should be < 50%
params$mean.po.thres <- c( "PO", ">", 1000) 
params$rt.range <- c(0.8, 30)         # c(0, 30), only keep peaks in 0 - 30 min
params$mean.thres <- c()

# Filter based on missings
params$filter_by_missing_feature_pct <- 50

# Missing imputation
params$missing.impute.method <- "LoD"  # "LoD", "HF", "median", "min", "mean"

render_rmarkdown(
    file = system.file("rmd", "04_Clean_peaktable.Rmd", package="metpipe"),
    #file = "04_Clean_peaktable.Rmd",
    params = params[params$Clean_peaktable],
    output = paste0( params$path.result, '04_Clean_peaktable')
  )

```

```{r 05_Normalization_comparison, eval = TRUE}

### Peaktable

params$path.peaktable.pos <- NULL
params$path.peaktable.neg <- NULL

params$peaktable.sep <- ";"
params$peaktable.sample.pattern <- NULL #".mzML Peak area"

params$mz_col_nr <- 1
params$rt_col_nr <- 2
params$identity_col_nr <- 3
params$sample_col_nr <- 5
params$others <- c(4)

### Processing parameters
# Filter based on missings

params$missing.sample.thres <- 30
params$missing.feature.thres <- 30

# Misssing imputation
# "LoD", "HF", "median", "min", "mean"

params$missing.impute.method.sample <- "LoD"  
params$missing.impute.method.is <- "LoD"

# Outlier removal

params$outliers.sample <- NULL
params$outliers.feature <- NULL
params$outliers.is <- NULL

# Sample types to remove from datatable
params$type.to.remove <- c("Met", "CA", "IQ", "sol", "BL")

# Normalization method
#c("bestis", "low_cv", "pqn", "nomis", "qspline", "loess", "sum", "median", "combat", "limma")

params$norm.method <- c("bestis", "low_cv", "sum", "median")

render_rmarkdown(
    file = system.file("rmd", "05_Normalization_comparison.Rmd", package="metpipe"),
    #file = "05_Normalization_comparison.Rmd",
    params = params[params$Normalization_comparison],
    output = paste0( params$path.result, '05_Normalization_comparison')
  )

```
